localFacts.fact: ImmoScout24 tells sellers to shoot listing photos in landscape format (its exposé view is optimised for Querformat), to shoot from a corner of the room, and to level the camera on a tripod at hip height (Hüfthöhe).

Panoramafreiheit (§ 59 UrhG) covers what passers-by see from public roads; the BGH (Hundertwasser-Haus, I ZR 192/00, 2003) said it no longer covers a view fixed from a place the public cannot access (there: a flat across the street). General information, not legal advice: for exteriors of architecturally protected buildings, shoot from the public pavement.
Benro Europe publishes 153 cm maximum height with the centre column retracted for the TMA38CL, a figure the US page leaves out.
German terms: Getriebeneiger (geared head), 3-Wege-Neiger, Kugelkopf, Mittelsäule, Nivellierbasis, Schnellwechselplatte; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.

localPainPoints.pain: Geared heads are slow to set and the Manfrotto 410 plate is hard to remove one-handed.
localPainPoints.fix: Use a geared head for interiors where precision beats speed; decide on a plate system first (410PL is proprietary) and plan an Arca adapter if the rest of the kit is Arca-Swiss.

quotes.text: Die Kameraplatte ist aufgrund ihrer Arretierung, einhändig nur schwer vom Getriebeneiger zu entfernen, was mit unter zeitaufwendig sein kann.
kein Stativkopf für eine schnelle, situationsbedingte Anpassung, da das Einstellen und Ausrichten mitunter zeitaufwendig sein kann

localPainPoints.pain: Only the Manfrotto plate fits the 410, which breaks an Arca-Swiss kit.
localPainPoints.fix: The English post's plate advice: pick the plate system before the head; the GEEKOTO and GorillaPod use Arca-type plates.

quotes.text: Leider kann nur die Manfrotto Kameraplatte genutzt werden, aber diese hält bombenfest in der Kopfaufnahme.

localGain.point: Benro's European column-down figure (153 cm) for the TMA38CL, which the English post marks as unpublished.
ImmoScout24's own photo advice (Querformat, corner position, level camera on a tripod at hip height) tied to column-down height.
Panoramafreiheit and the BGH Hundertwasser ruling for exterior shots: shoot from the public pavement, not from a neighbour's window.
German buyers' complaints about the 410 plate and setup speed answered with the plate-system advice.
